name: DSM-Firmenich AG
note: Swiss-law parent company of the dsm-firmenich group, dual-listed on Euronext Amsterdam and SIX Swiss Exchange (253,626,947 shares at 26 February 2026). Per the Dutch AFM register, notified holders of 3%+ include UBS Group AG (7.27%) and Artisan Investments GP LLC (5.04%); Firmenich family members hold smaller notified stakes. No state or state fund holds 3% or more.
